name: Assistant
description: A language model of your choice (model-runtime, Ollama, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible server) for typo fixes and prompt review before you send to an agent, command suggestions at the prompt, editor completions and a conversation in the palette. Nothing is sent until you pick a provider.

apiKey.description: API key for OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic or an OpenAI-compatible server that needs one. Stored encrypted on this computer, never synced.

provider.description: Where requests go. none sends nothing.

baseUrl.description: Provider address: http(s) URL or unix:/path.sock. Empty uses the provider's default (model-runtime: $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/model-runtime.sock, Ollama: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1). Required for openai-compatible.

fastModel.description: Small, fast model for typo fixes, prompt review, command suggestions and editor completions (model-runtime: gemma when empty). "Assistant: Models" lists what the provider has.

chatModel.description: Model for the palette conversation. Empty uses fastModel.

typos.description: Offer typo fixes for prompts you compose for an agent

promptReview.description: Review the quality of prompts you compose for an agent

commandSuggest.description: Suggest a shell command from a plain-language request at the prompt

editorCompletions.description: Inline completions in the editor (sends the code around the cursor)

chat.description: Ask the assistant from the command palette

requestsPerMinute.description: Most requests per minute for each feature (1 to 600)
